Akili Kids TV is the first and only dedicated free-to-air children's television network with imaginative and educative content that parents can trust and children will benefit from.

Akili Kids! - aspiring to be the most trusted Kenyan brand in children and family entertainment. Brought to you by Akili Network Ltd.

Morning Cloud TV Kenya believe in the consummation of all things including the visible personal return of Jesus Christ the resurrection of the dead and the translation of those alive in Christ into the presence of God.

TV47 Kenya is a television station headquartered in Nairobi. It broadcasts up-to-date news, talk shows, discussion programs, interview shows, music programs, sports-related programs such as EPL 2025/26 season, entertainment shows and children's programs in English and Swahili languages.

Citizen TV Kenya is a general news and entertainment television channel headquartered in Nairobi. It offers news bulletins, movies, TV series, music programs, talk shows, and other programs. 

Citizen TV is the leading television station in Kenya. It is the flagship brand of Royal Media Services and was founded in 1990 by Dr. S.K. Macharia as a private station. Citizen TV broadcasts in English and Kiswahili to audiences in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Rwanda.

The station is known for its authoritative and in-depth news coverage with a variety of segments: Day Break, Sema na Citizen, Monday Special, News Night, Jeff Koinange Live, Tonight, News Gang, Nipashe Wikendi, Friday Night, Citizen Weekend and Sunday Live

KTN Home Live stream for the latest news, politics, entertainment, and sport. Watch Kenya's first independent and authoritative channel 24/7.

It is headquartered at Standard Group Centre, Nairobi. It was the first free-to-air privately owned television network in Africa, and the first to break KBC TV monopoly in Kenya.

KTN Home (KTN Kenya Classics) Channel will bring you the most popular programs that were aired on KTN. Be sure to be entertained every day on this channel. The Home of Classics and Great Comedies of all time.

Ramogi TV is a 24-hour free-to-air channel offering general entertainment to customers and broadcasts in Dholuo language.

The channels programming line-up includes news, talk shows, commentaries, current, social, real life issues, news and educational content. Watch Ramogi TV online on kenyalivetv.co.ke on mobile. 

Ramogi TV is widely available on ADN, Signet, Citizen Digital app, Viusasa and YouTube.Ramogi TV is a 24 hour television station tailored for the Luo speaking audience as the primary target.

Romanza+ Africa is a premium Telenovela television channel compiled especially for Africa. Get your dose of love, betrayal and passion with new episodes everyday. Whether you are looking for a traditional love story or a romance filled with betrayal, action and drama Romanza+ Africa has it all for you.

Inooro TV Kenya is a vernacular TV station broadcasting in the Kikuyu language and speaking mostly to the people of Central Kenya commonly referred to as the Mt Kenya region.

Inooro TV programming features news bulletins, talk shows, dramas, soaps, documentaries, music shows, and religious programs. The Programing is tailor made to be in harmony with the interests and needs of the Kikuyu-speaking audience by showcasing local talent, cultural events, and relevant news stories.

KBC Channel 1 is a free-to-air television channel owned by Kenya Broadcasting Corporation (KBC TV), the state-run broadcasting organization of Kenya. The headquarters is located in Nairobi. 

It offers a wide range of programs, such as news bulletins, dramas, music shows, sitcoms, reality shows, animated shows, children's programs and more.
